title: MediaResult
description: Output contract for the bulk-media-intake pipeline. Extensible and BAD-D-agnostic by design -- this lab never invents or depends on BAD-D internal APIs. A future adapter (adapters/bulk-media-to-badd) translates this into whatever BAD-D's import/Testing Deck actually expects.

resultSchemaVersion.description: Semver of this schema shape, so old exported results stay interpretable as the schema evolves.

source.description: Where the input came from, before acquisition.

url.description: Only present for kind=authorized-url. Never a platform-scraping target -- see SECURITY.md.

sourceIdentity.description: Identity signals available BEFORE acquisition, used for early duplicate detection (cheap check before spending time/bandwidth on acquisition).

localIdentity.description: Identity established AFTER acquisition, from the actual bytes/content.

id.description: Stable local id for this result, e.g. hash-derived.

hash.description: Multiple identity levels -- filenames are never treated as reliable identity on their own.

audioContentHash.description: Cheap decoded-PCM-derived hash for near-duplicate detection across different containers/encodings of the same audio content. NOT a robust acoustic fingerprint -- see EXP-009 for what this cheap hash does and does not catch.

size.description: Bytes, redundant with localIdentity.byteLength for convenience.

changes.description: Human-readable list of what changed and why, e.g. 'peak-normalized to -1dBFS from -6.2dBFS'. Preserves provenance -- what we acquired vs what we changed.

experimentId.description: Which EXP-NNN record this result was produced under, for traceability.

provenance.description: Answers: what did we acquire, what did we change, why, original vs resulting identity.
